I'm not really good with CSS but I can understand it. I'm the mod over at /v/consoles and was just wondering how to add flairs. Thanks!

Here is how I did it in /v/steamsupport:

  1. Go to "flair settings"
  2. Click "Add a new link flair"
  3. Under "flair label" write what you would like the flair to say (flairname)

  4. Under "Flair CSS class name" type flair-flairname (EXAMPLE)

  5. Go to subverse settings

  6. Add to the custom stylesheet the following

.flair-flairname {

display: inline-block;

background-color: #A80000;

color: white;

}

Use this site to change the background and text colors. Repeat all the steps for each flair.

Update 2: I have the basics constructed and outlined, as well as help signs. Besides wool for banners, I only need one thing from you guys now: information. If you have any information on any guild that I have outlined above, please either comment or message me so I may include it in the list.

Old info: please disregard

Talk of guilds is new, and takes up a large portion of the global chat, and with good reason. The organizations allow for players to have a sense of community without forcing the players to partake in faction gameplay. However, without context, all of this is rather confusing, especially to new players. What guilds are there? How do you make a guild? What exactly is a guild anyways?

To better help index this information, consider this both a proposition and an advertisement for the Guild Guild, a small group for the sake of indexing a list of active guilds, brief information on each of them (as well as contact information, if the guild allows it), and general guild information. It's simple, by building a central base of operations in Tropia, we have an area that's accessible to much of the server population, and allows for guilds to display information without its members being on or restricting them to a certain location within their own headquarters to advertise otherwise.

Why am I doing this in public? Because, well, I only visit Tropia. I don't live in it, therefore I need help from some of the residents. In order for something like this to work, The location must be one that's easily noticeable and accessible within the city, but at the same time it must respect the people that have, so to speak, claimed all of the "good spots." So, not only am I asking Duey for permission to build in Tropia, but I'm asking you, the residents, to recommend me a location where this should be built, or for that matter if I should just look elsewhere for a place to build it like Slothington.

If this seems interesting enough that you would like to participate, leave a note in the comments. Just be aware that nothing gets established until the location is set. If you don't live in Tropia, that's fine. I listed it as the prime "first choice" location that I have in mind to make the directory.

Duey has allowed me to start building in Tropia to the right of spawn, and I have gotten started by constructed the basics of three rooms. Most of the structure is to be underground, with the exception of a small building for access. However, I do not feel as though I could display all of the information that I wish alone.

The first room of the base is to be an introductory one, to briefly explain what guilds on the server are, and to briefly explain the directory. The second room is to be the bulk of the structure, where a directory of guilds is places, listing four pieces of information: The name of the guild, the purpose of the guild, founders and contacts, and location (optional, but I hope to verify that each guild exists). The third room is to be the Guild Guild office, where a hopper leading into a chest collects books in case guilds wish to be listed, have information updated, and/or collect requests from candidates wish to join a guild while the master isn't online.

I plan to ask for help for three stages of this: with updates for each step. Primarily at the moment, I would like help in wording just what guilds are (my opening paragraph is way too wordy!).
